description: Compose a chain of 3D-aware post-processing passes (SSAO, SSR, DOF, motion blur) inside a new baseCOMP. Each pass is a glslTOP with companion textDAT that samples color + depth + (optional) normal/velocity AOVs from selectTOPs. Passes run in fixed order SSAO → SSR → DOF → MB and emit a final null TOP ('out1'). SSR is skipped with a warning when normal_top is empty; motion blur falls back to a directional blur when velocity_top is empty; if color_top points at a renderTOP and depth_top is empty, a sibling depthTOP is auto-created (best-effort). Returns container/output paths, the resolved AOV paths, the enabled passes, and any warnings.

color_top.description: Absolute path of the beauty-pass TOP (Render TOP / Null TOP).

depth_top.description: Absolute path of the depth TOP. Empty = auto-derive from a sibling depthTOP when color is a renderTOP.

name.description: Name of the created baseCOMP container.

normal_top.description: Absolute path of the normal-AOV TOP. Empty = SSR is skipped (warning).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP for the post-pass container.

velocity_top.description: Absolute path of the velocity-AOV TOP. Empty = motion blur falls back to directional.

name: post_passes_3d
title: 3D-aware post-processing passes
